description: Run a Playwright script with access to { page, context }. One tool call replaces 5-20 sequential MCP round trips. Use for complex flows with conditional logic, loops, error handling. NOTE: Scripts run in the Node.js process — equivalent to arbitrary code execution. Disable with LEAP_ALLOW_EXECUTE=false.

script.description: JavaScript async function body with access to { page, context }. Example: 'await page.goto("..."); return await page.title();'

name: execute
title: Execute Script
